Under the hood, the proven 3.6L V6 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission delivers smooth, confident power, while Jeeps advanced 4WD system and adaptive suspension provide capability on highways, city streets, and off-road trails. At Tim Short, this Grand Cherokee L Overland also comes with our Lifetime Powertrain Warranty at no additional costbecause Tim Short is home of the lifetime warranties.

The exterior design strikes the perfect balance of ruggedness and elegance. Signature Jeep styling is enhanced with 20-inch machined face aluminum wheels, LED lighting, a power moonroof, heated mirrors, rain-sensing wipers, power liftgate, and bold body-colored bumpers. Advanced camera systems, including the Integrated Off-Road Camera and Surround View Camera System, add confidence and convenience. Auto-leveling suspension ensures stability and comfort across all terrains, giving you more control whether cruising through city streets or navigating challenging trails.

Inside, the cabin delivers luxury, innovation, and versatility. The Overland trim offers Nappa leather seating throughout, with heated and ventilated front seats, power-adjustable massage functions for both driver and front passenger, heated second-row seating, and a reclining third row. The interior also includes a heated steering wheel, tri-zone climate control, and a panoramic design that creates a spacious feel. Split-folding seatbacks and ample cargo flexibility make it perfect for families, long road trips, and everything in between.

Technology takes center stage with the Uconnect 5 NAV system, featuring a crisp 10.1-inch touchscreen, navigation, wireless Apple CarPlay/Android Auto, wireless charging pad, and a premium 10-speaker sound system for immersive audio. Additional features such as the heads-up display, interior rear-facing camera, digital rearview mirror, and driver memory functions enhance convenience and connectivity.

Safety is fully integrated with Jeeps advanced driver-assist technology. Features include Night Vision with pedestrian and animal detection, Intersection Collision Assist, adaptive cruise control, lane keeping assist, blind-spot monitoring, ParkView rear backup camera with washer, electronic stability control, and forward collision warning. The Advanced Protech Group III package adds even more intelligent safety measures, making every drive secure and confident.

Everyday practicality blends seamlessly with luxury touches. Power-folding third-row seating, rear air conditioning, ambient lighting, rear reading lights, and plentiful storage make this SUV well-suited for families on the go. Whether used for commuting, road trips, or weekend adventures, the Grand Cherokee L Overland adapts to your lifestyle with comfort and ease.

Visit Tim Short today and experience why this SUV is the perfect fit for your familys needs and your adventures.

Discover the 2026 Jeep Grand Wagoneer Upland, a sophisticated three-row SUV designed for families who refuse to compromise on luxury, capability, or comfort.

- 3.0L I6 engine with 8-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD
- Uconnect 5 Nav with 12.0 touchscreen display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration

The Grand Wagoneer Upland combines classic heritage with modern engineering. The 3.0L I6 engine delivers responsive power while the advanced 4WD system with electronic locking rear differential handles any road condition. Ambient lighting and automatic temperature control with separate rear zones ensure all five passengers travel in personalized comfort.

Four-wheel independent suspension combined with speed-sensing steering adapts responsiveness to road conditions. The electronic rear limited slip differential optimizes traction without compromising handling.

Safety and awareness technology provide peace of mind. The Surround View Camera System displays a 360-degree view when maneuvering. Blind Spot with Trailer Detection alerts you to vehicles in adjacent lanes. Park and Unpark Assist with Stop System helps reduce parking stress. Comprehensive airbag systems, electronic stability control, and trailer brake control support confident vehicle operation.

The comprehensive feature set, including the three-panel sunroof, cargo cover, and removable rear tow hooks, addresses the needs of active families. 2022 GMC YUKON XL SLT 4WD 8 PASSENGER SUV POWERED BY THE 5.3L V8 ENGINE WITH ONLY 26,624 MILES! CLEAN CARFAX. ONE OWNER VEHICLE. ALL NEW CONTINENTAL TIRES! This SUV is ''SILVER CERTIFIED''. Read on to understand what a ''Silver Certified'' SUV is.

For transparent, convenient shopping we classify each of our pre-owned vehicles into 1 of 4 tiers: Gold Certified, Silver Certified, Bronze Certified, and Backlot Certified. The overall goal of this program is to provide a simple, efficient purchase experience.

To be Gold Certified, a vehicle must exceed PA's minimum safety standards by a significant margin. In addition, it must have matching name-brand tires with at least 50% tread remaining, as well as clean brake rotor surfaces with at least 50% pad life remaining. All systems must pass a full functionality test and no drivability issues may be present. All factory recommended services must be performed by one of our technicians. Further, the Carfax History Report may have no negative comments. And notably, its cosmetic condition must be virtually perfect inside and out. If the vehicle passes all of this criteria, it is ''Gold Certified''.

A Silver Certified vehicle is very similar. However it may have some minor blemishes that can be seen when performing a close-up inspection. In addition, a few minor Carfax issues may be present. Nontheless, one's first impression of these vehicles will be very positive.

A Bronze Certified vehicle will have some cosmetic flaws or damage that are noticeable-even when doing a quick walk-around inspection. However it will have met a mechanical criteria nearly identical to our higher tiers.

And now for ''Backlot''. The overall condition of a Backlot vehicle is the lowest we offer. Tires may be off-brand. Some holes may be noticeable in the carpet or seats. Damaged or repainted exterior panels may be quite noticeable, even from a distance. In spite of these lower standards, we still stand behind the ''Backlot'' tier with a basic version of our warranty. The beauty is in the savings!

Here's a bit of information about our company. We specialize in providing thoroughly inspected, serviced, detailed, pre-owned family vehicles and business vehicles. Our in-house, nation-wide ''Golden Rule Warranty'' backs issues not covered by remaining factory warranty as well as unexpected big dollar repairs on vehicles with expired factory warranty. It's included in all transactions gratis! We also offer nationwide transportation, airport pickup, and competive financing.

Above all, we strive to live out the GOLDEN RULE as taught by Jesus Christ- treating others as we wish to be treated. Delayed disclosure of major fees, hidden charges, poor customer service, polished incompentence, and such like violate His Sacred Rule.

All customers, whether Mr. Nice or Mr. Arm Twister, benefit from our market-based ''no haggle'' pricing model. Transactions that do not include a trade-in receive a small courtesy discount, and a package purchase of 2 or more vehicles receives more. Consideration is also given to a repeat of a recent purchase. To keep our document fees reasonable, we vary them according to the complexity of the transaction. Upon request, we'll provide an out-the-door proposal within a few minutes.

In summary, we strive to provide a simple, GOLDEN RULE experience for each customer-the Jones Family and the Jones Fleet. Nearby and far. For the first time and the 10th time. - Daryl and Miriam Martin (Owners)
